newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends higher in pre-report positioning.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends higher in pre-report positioning.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended higher on firmness in the cash market and on position-adjusting ahead of Wednesday's USDA grain production reports, traders said.
KCBT wheat was also supported by a strong performance in CBOT soybeans, which were higher on technicals and on concerns over the possibility of cool weather in the U.S. Midwest.
"Beans scored big, the cash (wheat) market was also firm, and that gave us support in front of the all-important USDA numbers," a trader said.
KCBT wheat closed two to six cents per bushel higher, with Sept up six cents at $4.55. Dec gained five cents to close at $4.52 per bushel.
Tuesday's wheat futures volumes were light, with the KCBT estimating wheat volume at 22.75 million bushels, versus 32.595 on Monday.
Traders said Man International bought around 1.7 million Dec bushels and Refco bought 900,000 Dec. CIS bought nearly two million July bushels and sold 1.5 million Dec, sources said.
